title: Hatsune Miku Symphony-初音未来交响乐
description:
In a gilded afternoon, the ink fragrance of old books intertwines with the lingering resonance of violin strings in the air.
Leaning against an exquisitely carved velvet chair, her long cyan-blue hair resembles melted glaciers, spreading across the floor along her silk skirt. Together with scattered sheet music and fluttering pages, it ripples with fine light patterns in the warm glow.
The brass horn of the gramophone still holds lingering melodies, and the black keys of the piano lie silent like poetry in the shadows. Yet her eyes brim with the light of half the room, like a songstress stepping out of the old days, gently tapping the secrets between pages and keys with her fingertips.
The wind drifts through the gaps of bookshelves, brushing the black ribbon in her hair, as well as those forgotten words and unfinished movements. In this study wrapped in light and sound, she is not an idol on stage, but a traveler sitting opposite old time, turning every strand of hair and every shadow into a flowing poem.
鎏金的午后，旧书的墨香与琴弦的余韵在空气里交织。
她斜倚在雕花绒椅上，青蓝色的长发如融化的冰川，顺着丝质裙摆漫过地板，与散落的乐谱、翻飞的纸页一同，在暖光里漾开细碎的光纹。
留声机的铜质喇叭还凝着未散的旋律，钢琴的黑键在阴影里沉默如诗，而她眼底盛着半室的光，像从旧时光里走出的歌者，正用指尖轻叩着书页与琴键间的秘密。
风穿过书架的缝隙，拂动她发间的黑丝带，也拂动了那些被遗忘的字句与未完成的乐章。在这间被光与音包裹的书房里，她不是舞台上的偶像，而是与旧时光对坐的旅人，让每一缕发丝、每一片光影，都成了一首流动的诗。

Dexter "Dex" Morgan is the title character and anti-hero/villain protagonist of the Showtime original series DEXTER, the special event series Dexter: New Blood, the prequel series Dexter: Original Sin, and the Dexter Novels.

Dexter was an elusive vigilante serial killer in Miami, known as "The Bay Harbor Butcher," who primarily targeted and killed other murderers who had escaped justice. His detailed method of killing allowed him to avoid the justice system by getting rid of any potential evidence.

The irony of Dexter's life was that he worked closely and affably with homicide detectives and a forensic specialist. Dexter, himself a blood spatter analyst, collected, processed, and interpreted evidence for the Miami Metro Police Department. He often used his ability to access police databases or tamper with evidence for his personal advantage.

title: The Ultimate Steven Universe Barn Wallpaper
description:
A customizable 4K wallpaper based on the barn title cards of Steven Universe.
Everything is rendered on engine, from the blinking stars to the flying clouds to even every single swaying leave.
The wallpaper can be set between all the versions shown on the show (Night, Dawn, Day or Sunset) or it can be set to smoothly transition between them through the day, with adjustable time of transition and blend duration.
There are also two new original versions (Raining and Snowing) to match the temple title cards. When switching the weather, there will be a smooth transition, although it will override the time-of-day transitions.
The hanged clothes, including the rope and pole, can be toggled off if you want just a view of the empty field. You can also disable the snow/rain particles.
There is also a toggleable Clock and Date made to look like the title cards on the show. The colors in them change with the rest of the wallpaper. The clock can be set to 24H or 12H and the date can be displayed on English or Spanish.


I consider this version 2.9.1, aka the last version (excluding hypothetical hotfixes). I literally can’t come up with any feature worth adding, so I’m renaming it to “The Ultimate Steven Universe Barn Wallpaper” and calling it finished. Although I am open to suggestions.
This is the first entry of the “The Ultimate Steven Universe Wallpapers” collection. Here is a link to the collection:
https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3500057300



Credits:
Tons of thanks to Phizzy who not only inspired me to do this wallpaper but also provided the original assets for 1.0 which later I heavily modified or even recreated for this 2.0 (now 2.9.1). Here are links to their YouTube channel, and the tutorial that inspired me:
https://www.youtube.com/@Phizzy
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zHMpFomcyv8

The Clock uses several modified versions of the Crewniverse Font, recreated by MaxiGamer:
https://www.deviantart.com/maxigamer/art/Crewniverse-Font-V-5-MORE-ACCENTS-AND-SYMBOLS-540122768

The Date uses the Impallari Dosis (Extra Bold) font:
https://www.fontsquirrel.com/fonts/dosis

The clouded sky of the raining and snowing version was constructed from a background of the episode “Lars and the Cool Kids” by the Crewniverse and shared on Tumblr:
https://www.tumblr.com/stevencrewniverse/79768471684/a-selection-of-backgrounds-from-the-steven?source=share
